name: example-spec-template
description: Rules for the generic example template that ships with AIDevWorkflow. Copy and adapt for your own template.

patterns.message: write acceptance criteria as: Given …, when …, then ….

tables.message: every edge case needs a situation and a specific expected behavior.

judgment.rule: Every requirement is specific and testable
Every edge case has a specific expected behavior
Proposed structures are based on the inspected project and cite the existing code they follow
Every requirement can be verified by an acceptance criterion, edge case, done item or named test

questions.interrupted: The app or page closes mid-operation
questions.concurrent: Someone else changes the same data at the same time
questions.stale: Data changed since the user loaded it
questions.lost-response: The request succeeded but the response was lost

advisory.message: 'Not included' says None; list what a reader might wrongly assume is part of this.
Name the required tests in the Definition of done.

prompts: Who computes each value: the server or the client?
Which existing behavior must stay unchanged?
